purpose: Minimal cross-domain criteria for allowing an observation to resolve an external effect.

rules.rule: An observation cannot resolve an effect unless it is bound to the same logical_effect_id.
An observation cannot resolve an effect unless it was obtained after the relevant attempt.
Stale or cached evidence cannot move UNRESOLVED to CONFIRMED or CONTRADICTED.
The observation source must be authorized by an external authority policy for the claimed effect domain and observation kind.
Model estimates, transport acknowledgements, and unprovenanced values are not authoritative effect observations by themselves.
If any required authority condition is missing or the source is not allowed by policy, verdict remains UNRESOLVED.
